content.value: A group of 20 trunks provides a grade of service of 0.01 when offered 12E of traffic. (i) How much is the grade of service improved if one extra trunk is added to the group? (ii) How much does the grade of service deteriorate if one trunk is out of service?

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 4th Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2015
